claims.claim: Aeva remains loss-making and capital-dependent: its June 30, 2026 10-Q reports an accumulated deficit of $871.9M, expects continued operating losses, and identifies possible additional debt/equity needs if customer programs are delayed.

Commercial scaling remains a core falsifier because competitiveness depends on producing perception solutions at customer-required volumes and cost points while global ADAS sensing competition can pressure pricing, margins and share.

Financing risk is not hypothetical but should not be overstated: June 2026 liquidity was $177.9M and management stated available liquidity plus the standby equity facility was expected to fund at least 12 months, while the facility can create equity dilution if used.

risks: continued operating losses and external-capital dependence
potential equity dilution through standby financing

contradictions.contradiction: Improved liquidity coexists with continued operating losses and a financing structure that can dilute holders if commercialization timing slips.

unknowns: timing and amount of future standby-equity draws
customer-specific production conversion and gross-margin economics
falsifiers: Sustained positive operating cash flow without material equity issuance would weaken the financing-dependence risk.
Series-production conversion at competitive unit economics would weaken the scale/cost execution risk.

assist.changedStrategy: Used current SEC 10-Q risk/liquidity disclosures rather than repeating prior issuer design-win evidence.
